events.title: Fall Used Book Sale
events.description:
As crisp autumn air begins to usher in autumn, there’s no better way to embrace the season than by wandering through the Fall Used Book Sale at the Laurens County Library, September 21st to October 31st.

Fall Finds

Fall Used Book Sale features books on cooking, crafts, kids, and characters. The sale will also feature fiction titles, biographies, VHS movies and audio books on cassette. Admission is free, so bring a few totes to carry all your finds!

This much-anticipated event invites book lovers of all ages to explore countless gently-used treasures. With hardcovers, DVDs, and Blu-rays available for just $1 each, and everything else for only 50¢, you can stock up on stories for cozy nights ahead without breaking the bank. To make your shopping experience even smoother, the library encourages cash payments—small bills preferred for quicker service.

Dublin-Laurens County Library is located at 801 Bellevue Avenue, and is open Monday through Thursday 9 AM to 7 PM, Friday 9 AM to 5 PM, Saturday 10 AM to 2 PM,  and closed Sundays.

For more information and a lot more events throughout the year, visit Laurens County Library online.

Reading Retreat

After you’ve filled your tote with new finds, why not have a snug autumn afternoon with a trip to Mission Bake Shoppe? Curl up with your new favorite autobiography and a warm cup of coffee, or stop by Crooked Finger Brewing to get wrapped up in a spirited romance novel paired with a spicy craft brew.

events.title: Dublin Farm Dinners
events.description:
Feast like royalty at Dublin Farm on Fridays and Saturdays with the Dublin Farm Feast, a five-course experience featuring handcrafted, refined international dining specialties. Each week, the chef thoughtfully creates a fresh, flavorful menu using only the finest produce, herbs, and high quality ingredients for an unforgettable dining experience.

Reservations, Please!

Start your culinary tour by reserving a table at Dublin Farm with an easy reservation online or by sending a private message here on Facebook. When making your reservation, please inform Dublin Farm of your entree selection in advance. Enjoy a memorable multi-course dinner priced at $65 per person, plus tax and gratuity, with iced tea, water, and coffee included. Soft drinks, cappuccino, espresso, hot chocolate, hot tea, beer, and wine are also available for purchase.

October 16th | October 17th

Course One

Cranberry & Feta Salad
mixed greens with dried cranberries, crumbled feta, cucumber, cherry tomatoes, and toasted almonds, finished with a balsamic vinaigrette

Course Two

Creamy Tuscan Mushrooms
sauteed mushrooms with garlic, spinach, and sun-dried tomatoes in a Parmesan cream sauce, served with toasted crostini 

Course Three

Choose One Entree
Served with seasonal sides and vegetables
Thick-Cut Bone-In Pork Chop
seared pork chop finished with a bourbon glaze and caramelized onions 
Lemon-Caper Butter Snapper
pan-seared snapper finished with a lemon-caper butter and fresh parsley

Chicken Breast with Dijon Cream
pan-seared chicken breast topped with a whole-grain Dijon cream sauce and fresh thyme 

Course Four

 SORBET

Apple Cider Sorbet
refreshing apple cider sorbet with a hint of cinnamon

Course Five

Dessert

Warm Pumpkin Bread Pudding
finished with vanilla cream sauce and caramel drizzle 

Food Coma

Find yourself slipping into the most marvelous of food comas? No worries! Book a stay at Dublin Farm Bed & Breakfast, where the coziest of private suites and a homemade breakfast await. There’s nothing quite like starting your day with a feast.

events.title: Concerts at Theatre Dublin
events.description:
Theatre Dublin lights up the stage with an assortment of tribute concerts throughout the year. Grab the whole crew and jam out to classic tunes that everyone loves, presented by people with a passion for playing!

Tribute Concerts

Tickets for General Admission are $20. VIP Tickets are $25. Become a Rock & Roll Concert Club Member for $105 for seating at all 4 concerts, early entry, and more perks. Click the links below for advance ticketing options.

  • October 16th, 2026: To the Limit – The Ultimate Eagles Experience

A premium touring tribute act that faithfully recreates the timeless country-rock sound and soaring vocal harmonies of The Eagles.

  • January 23rd, 2027: DEPARTURE – The Journey Tribute Band

DEPARTURE replicates the look, sound and feel of the original 80’s rock super group, Journey. These veteran musicians love what they do and have developed an amazing on-stage chemistry.

  • April 24th, 2027: The Seger Experience

The Seger Experience pays impeccable attention to detail and delievers the same outstanding energy of Bob Seger’s live concerts that you know and love.

All Tribute concerts start 7 PM. Concert Club members enter at 6 PM. General Reserved ticket holders enter at 6:30 PM.

Theatre Dublin

Built in 1934 and renovated in 1996, Theatre Dublin serves as a performing arts center for Dublin‐Laurens County and surrounding areas. Theatre Dublin can accommodate over 600 people and has state‐of‐the‐art sound and lighting equipment. The theatre is owned by the City of Dublin and managed by the Dublin Downtown Development Authority. It is used primarily for live productions and concerts with special showings of movies throughout the year.

Have questions about ticketing or booking Theatre Dublin? Please contact 478-272-2560 or email info@dtdublin.com.

events.title: Downtown Dublin Chili Cook-Off & Fall Festival
events.description:
What better way to get into all of the fall feelings than with a belly full of chili and full day of fun! Dig into the Downtown Dublin Chili Cook-Off and Fall Festival on Saturday, October 17th from 12 PM to 4 PM to indulge in all the savory tastings local teams conjure up.

Chili Cook-Off

What do you call legumes that warm your heart and are the coolest around? “Chilly” Beans! Chow down on a cup of heart warming chili from Dublin GA’s favorite community teams at the Market on Madison in Downtown Dublin GA. After the chili tasting is done, vote your favorite for the People’s Choice Award!

Fall Festival

Want even more fall-tastic fun? Forget the autumn-mobile! Just steps from the steaming pots of chili, experience a FREE fall festival including vendors, entertainment, food trucks, and a kids’ zone. Inflatables, rides, face painting, pumpkin carving/painting contest, and yard games keep the kiddos entertained. Local DJ Brandon Chain provides a little musical entertainment.

If you say, “My chili is always ready for a challenge—it loves to bring the heat!” Check out the info below. 

Tickets and Vendors

Dig into delicious samplings of homemade chili with Tasting Tickets:

  • 1 Ticket: $1 each
  • 7 Tickets: $5
  • 12 Tickets: $10
Team Registration Information:

Do you have the tastiest chili in town? Prove you know your way around a chili pot by signing up for the Chili Cook-Off!

Click here for registration. Submit your application no later than October 2nd, 2026.

Chili Teams will have 5 gallons of chili ready for the tasting. Each team will be assigned 10′ by 10′ spaces. Cash prize and trophies for 1st, 2nd, 3rd, and 4th place & Best Decorated Booth!

For more info on team sign-ups and sponsorship opportunities, contact Downtown Dublin at info@DTDublin.com or call 478-272-2560.

Vendor Registration Information:

45 vendors will be selected to participate in the 4th Annual Downtown Chili Cook-Off and Fall Festival.

Click here for registration. Submit your application no later than October 2nd, 2026.

For more info for vendor registration, contact Nichole Padgett at nichole@dublinmainstreet.com or call 478-272-2560.
